title: Materials Data Handbook: Aluminum Alloy 7075 (1966 edition, NASA CR-80764; 2nd edition 1972, NASA CR-123773)
publisher: NASA George C. Marshall Space Flight Center (1966: Syracuse University, eds. J. Sessler, V. Weiss; 1972: Western Applied Research & Development, rev. R. F. Muraca, J. S. Whittick)

reuse.basis: NTRS record metadata: distribution PUBLIC; copyright determination GOV_PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED (U.S. Government work under NASA contracts NAS8-11345 and NAS8-26644).

files.note: title pages and the cited page of each edition: the PDFs' embedded OCR text layer, extracted with pypdf 6.19.0 (PdfReader.extract_text), unmodified

used: One sentence, 'Melting range is approximately 477 to 638 C' (1966 p.19; 1972 p.18, section 3.3). Accepted because both independently scanned editions read the same numbers and unit; recorded as melting_temperature 477 degC (range onset), alloy-level link to non-clad 7075 records.
not_used: All elevated-temperature strength and modulus data (figures and scanned tables: OCR not reliable enough and values would have to be read off curves). The handbooks state no maximum service temperature for 7075.
caveats: Melting range is a physical transition, not a service temperature; it never satisfies a max-service-temperature requirement.
